title: 14-BCV-015 - Multi-level storage racking systems
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
code_edition: Alberta Building Code 2014 and Alberta Fire Code 2014
catalogue_status: Catalogue row is not marked [WITHDRAWN]; PDF carries an Archived watermark.

facts.text: The STANDATA permits multi-level storage racking systems to be considered special and unusual structures under ABC Sentence 3.2.2.2.(1), subject to its stated conditions.
facts.locator: 14-BCV-015 PDF, pp.1-2, PURPOSE, CODE REFERENCES and VARIANCE

facts.text: It limits stated occupancies to medium/low-hazard industrial or mercantile and requires employee-only access, a fire safety plan, structural design, fire protection, lighting/emergency power and egress provisions.
